batch.description: University of Chittagong (CU) A Unit question-bank collection — 2011-2012. 94 questions (Bangla 10, English 15, Physics 24, Chemistry 25, Higher Mathematics 20). Answer status: 55 verified / 39 unverified; this reflects answer-key review status, not an assertion that the question text is flawless. Import QA 2026-11-19: 22 subject labels corrected; cross-batch source IDs made importer-safe; source-conflicted keys remain unverified. This is a historical question-bank collection, not a claim that the pack count equals the official exam quota. the rest carry their best single-source key or no key, flagged per question. Explanations are null throughout (no cleanly alignable source). AI-solved keys (2026-11-18, not source-verified): 18. Keyless: 3. QA audit 2026-11-19: see QA_AUDIT_REPORT.md.
